footerNote: Net income here is Palantir's total net income of $97M; $93.4M of it is attributable to common stockholders (the remaining $3.5M belongs to noncontrolling interests) — the release's $93M headline is the attributable figure. Palantir reports in thousands; figures are rounded to whole $M, with gross profit shown as $499M (reported $499.7M) so the rounded lines tie exactly to reported totals. Segment figures are from the earnings release (this is a fourth quarter, so no FY-minus-9M derivation was needed).
otherDetail: Interest income of $44.5M on Palantir's cash pile, less $0.1M of interest expense and $4.0M of other expense, net — mainly losses on equity securities and foreign-currency moves — a net +$40M below operating profit, rounded.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Software for companies — U.S. commercial revenue jumped 70% to $131M as the AIP 'bootcamp' push kept winning customers, and the U.S. commercial customer count grew 55% to 221.

takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue grew 70% YoY to $131M, the U.S. commercial customer count grew 55% to 221, and U.S. commercial total contract value grew 107%.
takeaways.title: U.S. business customers surged

takeaways.text: GAAP net income was $97M in total ($93M attributable to common stockholders), with GAAP operating income of $66M — an 11% margin — and GAAP EPS of $0.04, up from $0.01 a year ago.
takeaways.title: Fifth straight profitable quarter

takeaways.text: Adjusted free cash flow was $305M — 50% of revenue — and cash from operations was $301M; Palantir ended the year with $3.7B of cash, cash equivalents and short-term U.S. Treasury securities.
takeaways.title: Cash generation was the standout

verdict: Palantir's revenue grew 20% to $608M as U.S. commercial sales jumped 70%, delivering a fifth straight quarter of GAAP profitability.
